Name: DeepWoods SVE warp fix
Author: Liink56
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Originally, within "MapPatches, which handles compatibility between vanilla maps (as modified by SVE) and most well-known mod, the condition pertaining to the "DeepWood" mod references an obsolete identifier.

This mod simply updates that line to resolve the issue.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Simply install and extract this mod into the same folder as SVE; it will overwrite the original MapPatches file to apply the fix. Nothing else has been changed, aside from the Deepwood identifier. If you have made your own custom modifications, please manually replace "maxvollmer.deepwoodsmod" with "maxmakesmods.deepwoodsmod".[/color]



[b][size=4]Thanks to the creators of SVE and Deepwoods; these mods are fantastic, and I highly recommend them to you here :[/size]
